About The Brand

 

Welcome to Pink Zipper, where dreams are not only cherished but celebrated, and where individuality reigns supreme in a world that once doubted its potential. We are proud to announce that we have officially become a legal entity as of last Friday, and this milestone marks the beginning of a journey that defied skeptics and embraced the power of authenticity.

Our founder's story is one of resilience and determination, for Pink Zipper was not born without challenges. It was a dream that people cast aside, dismissed as foolish, and even attempted to crush. But our visionary founder stood strong, unyielding in her belief that fashion could be more than just conformity; it could be a vessel of self-expression and empowerment.

Throughout her college years, she encountered voices that told her she had to conform, that she had to dress in a certain way to fit the mold of the business world. But she refused to succumb to such limitations, for Pink Zipper was founded on the belief that one's style and appearance should never dictate their worth or credibility.

In a world that too often stifles creativity, Pink Zipper emerged as a vibrant oasis, where a hot pink blazer and blue hair are not only accepted but embraced as unique expressions of individuality. We stand proudly as a symbol of authenticity, inspiring others to be unapologetically themselves in every environment they encounter.

At Pink Zipper, we believe that dreams are the seeds of greatness, and we have nurtured this dream into a reality that celebrates the power of following one's passion. We stand as a testament to the fact that perseverance and self-belief can defy all odds.

Our commitment to professionalism extends beyond appearances. We understand that our customers deserve a brand that embodies integrity and excellence in all aspects of our interactions. From customer service to the quality of our designs, we aim to provide a level of professionalism that reflects the spirit of innovation and authenticity that defines Pink Zipper.

Join us on this extraordinary journey, where fashion is not just about clothes, but a canvas for storytelling, self-expression, and empowerment. Let Pink Zipper be the beacon that reminds you to chase your dreams relentlessly and be proud of who you are, in every space and every moment.

We are Pink Zipper, and we invite you to be a part of our unique community, where dreams find their wings, and individuality shines as the guiding star. Together, let's redefine the world of fashion and show the world that being true to yourself is the most powerful and beautiful statement one can make.

 

Our Goals

An extraordinary opportunity awaits you at Pink Zipper's Affiliate & Ambassador Program, exclusively crafted for fashion-forward trailblazers like you.

Partner with us at mypinkzipper.com and immerse yourself in a world of exclusive collections, reserved only for our esteemed collaborators and cool collections for everyone. Be the first to lay hands on cutting-edge designs, enjoy sneak peeks of upcoming collections, and flaunt ensembles that set trends before they hit the market.

Our rewards and benefits program is as opulent as our designs. Earn 10% commissions with every successful referral, and watch your rewards grow as your influence soars. But that's not all; gain access to exclusive events, fashion shows, and behind-the-scenes experiences (Georgia, USA) to ignite your passion for fashion.

Pink Zipper's Affiliate & Ambassador Program empowers you to champion our message of self-expression, embracing individuality, and fostering confidence. Dare to make a difference, as you inspire others to find their authentic selves.

Ready to seize this thrilling opportunity? Don't wait;  Join us today and shape the future of fashion!

What we sell

  • Pink Zipper Couture: Classy looks with a modern twist
  • Pink Zipper Adornments: Artistic Jewelry
  • Pink Zipper Sport: Modern Activewear
  • Pink Zipper Lost Garden (Carats Only): Fine Jewelry from 1 carat to 12 carats with certificates of authenticity
  • And more!
